title: GPT-6 Astra First Impressions: Can It Handle My Old iOS App?
description:
Made with Restream. Livestream on 30+ platforms at once via https://restream.io

I finally have GPT-6 Astra, and we’re putting it to work on a real iOS app that I haven’t worked on in a long time.
This has been a crazy week for AI models, with new releases from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta. We’ll briefly look at how Astra compares with Claude Fable 5.1, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Muse Spark 1.3.
Some of the coding benchmarks are really interesting. Astra and Fable are extremely close on several tests, while Meta’s Muse actually comes out ahead on some agent benchmarks. But benchmarks can be weird depending on the tools, reasoning settings, and test setup.
That’s why I want to test Astra on something real.
Can it understand an existing Swift project I haven’t touched in a long time? Can it figure out where I left off, make useful changes, debug problems, and actually help me get productive again?
Astra API pricing is $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens. Claude Fable 5.1 is also $10/$50, while Gemini 3.8 Flash is dramatically cheaper.
So is Astra actually good enough to justify the price?
Let’s find out live.
